description: Use this when the user wants a delivery a webhook or chat channel missed sent again, once the endpoint is fixed. Sends the same event again as a new attempt, as the Webhooks page's Retry does, and returns whether it arrived and the HTTP status. Owners and admins only. Not for a test event (use test_webhook).

webhook.description: The webhook's id (from list_webhooks) or its name.

name: retry_webhook_delivery
title: Send a webhook delivery again
